headword: {共働|ともばたら}き{世帯|せたい}

definitions.explanation: A household where both partners work and earn income. A frequently discussed topic in Japanese society regarding work-life balance, childcare, and economic trends.

examples.japanese: {共働|ともばたら}き{世帯|せたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
{共働|ともばたら}き{世帯|せたい}⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧、⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: Securing a daycare spot is a major challenge for dual-income households.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{共働|ともばたら}き{世帯|せたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{専業|せんぎょう}{主婦|しゅふ}→専業主婦：16565_sengyoushufu⟧⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: In Japan, dual-income households have come to outnumber households with a stay-at-home spouse.

notes:
A compound frequently used in news, government statistics, and social commentary about Japanese demographics and economic trends. The rise of dual-income households is one of the most significant social changes in modern Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共働|ともばたら}き{世帯|せたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧: proportion of dual-income households
- {共働|ともばたら}き{世帯|せたい}{向|む}け⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: services aimed at dual-income households
- {共働|ともばたら}き{世帯|せたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦{分担|ぶんたん}→分担：11771_buntan⟧: division of housework in dual-income households

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{共働|ともばたら}き→共働き：08564_tomobataraki⟧: dual income, both spouses working
- ⟦{専業|せんぎょう}{主婦|しゅふ}→専業主婦：16565_sengyoushufu⟧: full-time homemaker
- {片働|かたばたら}き: single-income (household)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Since the 1990s, dual-income households have steadily increased in Japan, overtaking single-earner households. This shift has driven demand for childcare services, meal kits, and household convenience products.
